sections.title: What does this company do?
sections.content: Graphy is an India-based creator-economy platform that helps educators, coaches, and experts launch and monetize online courses, memberships, and live learning experiences.

sections.title: Who are its customers?
sections.content: Independent educators, coaches, trainers, and subject-matter experts building knowledge businesses, with strong relevance in India and growing creator-education markets globally. Secondary users include learners and community members enrolled in creator programs.

sections.title: What products or services does it offer?
sections.content: Course hosting, community features, payment and checkout flows, mobile apps for creators, marketing tools, live classes, and membership products. Graphy positions itself as an all-in-one stack for creators who want to own audience and revenue.

sections.title: What is its business model?
sections.content: Primarily SaaS subscriptions and platform fees on creator revenue. Growth depends on helping creators succeed quickly, reducing churn, and expanding ARPU through community, live learning, and premium creator tooling.

sections.title: What recent developments matter?
sections.content: Continued competition in the creator-education stack from global and regional players. Product emphasis appears oriented toward mobile creator workflows, community retention, and helping experts move beyond one-off course launches.

sections.title: What hiring patterns are visible?
sections.content: Hiring signals across product, engineering, growth, and customer success roles typical of a scaling creator SaaS company. AJ has firsthand product familiarity as a teacher and course creator on the platform.

sections.title: What strategic challenges may exist?
sections.content: Graphy may need to differentiate beyond course hosting as creators demand better UX, AI-assisted workflows, community depth, and outcomes beyond transactional course sales. Educator onboarding and product clarity remain critical levers.

sections.title: Why might AJ create value here?
sections.content: AJ brings lived educator experience on Graphy plus systems thinking across product, teaching, and creator business models. He could help shape educator onboarding, AI-enabled creator workflows, and product strategy grounded in real classroom and course-creation friction.
